comment: Inputs 13 and 14 are declared in the code as level CV jacks but are not placed on the panel and are never read, so they carry no line. The LEVEL knobs therefore have no CV input. The two CLEAR inputs need a full 10V. Delay.cpp:368 and 480 divide the jack by ten and clamp the result to 0 to 1 before handing it to a trigger whose threshold is 1, so anything under 10V never reaches it with the button at rest. The two TIME inputs behave differently in the two clock modes: free running, the jack is clamped to 0 to 1 on its own, so a negative voltage does nothing; clocked, the knob and jack are summed first and a negative voltage pulls the knob down.
